summary: In April 2018 TSB moved about five million customer records to a new platform, Proteo4UK, in a single weekend. Customers could not access accounts for days. An independent review by Slaughter and May, published in November 2019, found weak testing, poor supplier oversight and an unassessed big-bang approach.

overview.background: TSB left Lloyds Banking Group's systems and moved to a platform from its owner. The migration involved over 70 suppliers and more than 1,400 people.
overview.impact: Customers had trouble accessing services and contacting the bank. Branches had major problems. Attempted fraud peaked at 70 times usual levels.
overview.severity: Severe. Disruption lasted into the spring and summer of 2018.
overview.gaps: TSB disputed parts of the report and pointed to inconsistent data centre configuration.

timeline.e: TSB migrates five million customer records in a single weekend.
Customers cannot access accounts or reach the bank; branches struggle.
Attempted fraud peaks at 70 times usual levels.
TSB works through technical issues over several days and months.
TSB says it changed its leadership structure and took direct control of IT operations.

rootCause.trigger: TSB moved all records in one weekend without assessing alternatives.
rootCause.underlying: The review found weak testing, gaps in the board's understanding and poor supplier oversight.
contributing: No assessment of the big-bang approach

evidence.label: The testing finding
evidence.body: lack of robust testing with regards to the new system
evidence.note: As quoted in ITPro's report on the review.

evidence.label: The fraud measure
evidence.note: As quoted in the same report.

diagnose.step: Check test coverage against production behaviour.

correct.step: Take direct control of IT operations.

fix.safety: Moving financial records is irreversible without a tested rollback. Do not proceed without one.

troubleshoot.scenario: You plan to migrate millions of customers in a weekend. Testing is incomplete and two data centres are not identical.
troubleshoot.question: What do you advise?
troubleshoot.answer: Phase the migration, test at scale and across both sites, keep rollback and delay if gates are not met.

design.answer: Phased waves, parallel run, parity checks, rollback and strong oversight.
